Fonts used by Realmkeeper's interface (Phase 19). The owner approved the SIL Open Font License 1.1 for fonts on
2026-11-12. These fonts are OFL 1.1, NOT CC0 or CC BY.

EB Garamond (headings, dialogue): EBGaramond-Regular, -SemiBold and -Italic.ttf
  Copyright 2017 The EB Garamond Project Authors. Source: https://github.com/octaviopardo/EBGaramond12
  (static TTFs from fonts/ttf). Licence: EBGaramond/OFL.txt

Alegreya Sans (body text, controls, statistics): AlegreyaSans-Regular, -Medium, -Bold and -Italic.ttf
  Copyright 2013 The Alegreya Sans Project Authors. Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/alegreyasans
  Licence: AlegreyaSans/OFL.txt

OFL terms followed:
- the fonts ship with the game and its licence texts;
- the fonts are not sold on their own;
- the files are unmodified, so no Reserved Font Name issue arises.
